title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization helps in feature selection by adding a penalty to the model complexity. This penalty term is added to the loss function to discourage overly complex models.

title: L1 vs L2 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to produce sparse models by driving some coefficients to zero, effectively selecting features. L2 regularization, or Ridge, tends to shrink coefficients but rarely makes them exactly zero.
